name: When should appliance hookups be coordinated during a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should appliance hookups be coordinated during a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on whether the appliances stay where they are or need new utility runs. If the layout is simple, coordination may be done during design and installation planning; if walls, cabinets, or utility lines move, it should be resolved before demo and rough-in work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordinate hookups before demolition or rough-in whenever appliance locations are changing. The earlier the plumbing, electrical, gas, and venting are confirmed, the fewer delays you will have later.
